results.notes: Sources: PDF pp. 8-12 and 14; full markdown and Appendices A-D reviewed. CoCreativityDF.csv has 263 unique IDs, with one scored story per condition and no missing originality scores. Use every released row, without further exclusions. The paper removed 68 external-aid users, 53 attention-check failures, and 7 intelligence-test outliers before reporting this final sample; the release does not contain the 128 excluded participants or their flags. Prompt-count outlier exclusions on PDF pp. 15-16 concern correlational analyses and do not apply to this paired contrast. Treatment is Originality_AIhelp; control is Originality_noAI. Originality_DifferenceScore equals treatment minus control to numerical precision. All originality and word-count values also match row for row in both Study1 CSVs from osf-b4ztn, despite different ID labels. The latter release's Mplus exclusion of ID 109087 removes no supplied row. Study2 contains different tasks and samples and is not used for this contrast. Arm SDs use denominator n-1 across people. The paired difference is mean(treatment_i-control_i), and its SE is SD(treatment_i-control_i, ddof=1)/sqrt(n). Counts refer to the same 263 people in both conditions, not 526 independent people. The PDF literally prints both arm SDs as '08'; no numeric printed-SD comparison is made. The SDs below are computed from posted scores. The printed d matches paired d_z, but its intended standardizer is not identified by the paper. Likewise, a paired-t confidence interval reproduces the printed bounds without establishing their unstated target. No scores were rescaled. Condition order is absent, preventing a first_round contrast; participant IDs and CSV row positions are not treated as order. All participants had a practice task with AI available before the two scored conditions, and the all-round estimate may include order or carryover effects.

skipped.reason: round first_round: the full-sample paired result is reproduced, but neither CoCreativityDF.csv nor either shared-sample Study1 CSV contains randomized condition order, first-condition labels, or story timestamps. PDF p. 9 reports randomized order but no participant-level mapping or analyzed counts by order. A first-round HC2 contrast and its arm counts cannot be recovered without guessing.

Rounds all and first_round skipped under rule 5. PDF pp. 11-12 define a leave-one-story-out change in the mean pairwise semantic distance of each prompt-specific pool, using final-layer paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 embeddings after removal of prompt words. CoCreativityDF.csv supplies only stored Diversity_AIhelp, Diversity_noAI, and Diversity_DifferenceScore values; it supplies no story texts, prompt assignments, or embeddings. Both shared-sample Study1 CSVs also lack these inputs. Texts in the supplied Study2 release belong to a different study. Consequently the original embedding and reference-pool procedure cannot be recomputed exactly. Stored contributions are not substituted for a recomputed set-diversity measure or treated as independent participant outcomes. First-round condition order is also unavailable.
